context_title:
---- MODULE consensus ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, TLC, Sequences

CONSTANTS nodes, MaxTerm
VARIABLES term, votedFor, log, state, messages

vars == <<term, votedFor, log, state, messages>>

Node == nodes
Term == 0..MaxTerm
LogEntry == [term: Term, value: {0,1}]
BallotNumber == [term: Term, node: Node]
Log == Seq(LogEntry)

InitVoteMsg == [type: "RequestVote", from: Node, to: Node, term: Term]
VoteMsg == [type: "Vote", from: Node, to: Node, term: Term, vote: BOOLEAN]
AppendEntriesMsg == [type: "AppendEntries", from: Node, to: Node, term: Term, log: Log]
AppendEntriesReplyMsg == [type: "AppendEntriesReply", from: Node, to: Node, term: Term, success: BOOLEAN]

Message == Union {InitVoteMsg, VoteMsg, AppendEntriesMsg, AppendEntriesReplyMsg}
Messages == SUBSET Message

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in Term
  /\ votedFor \in [Node -> Option BallotNumber]
  /\ log \in SUBSET Log
  /\ state \in [Node -> {"leader", "follower", "candidate"}]
  /\ messages \in SUBSET Messages

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ votedFor = [n \in Node |-> NONE]
  /\ log = << >>
  /\ state = [n \in Node |-> "follower"]
  /\ messages = {}

NoLeaderInTwoTerms(t) ==
  \A n1, n2 \in Node:
    \E ts \in 1..t:
      /\ state[n1] = "leader" /\ term[n1] = ts
      /\ state[n2] = "leader" /\ term[n2] = ts
    => n1 = n2

LogMatching(n1, n2, idx) ==
  /\ Len(log[n1]) >= idx
  /\ Len(log[n2]) >= idx
  /\ \A i \in 1..idx:
       log[n1][i] = log[n2][i]

LeaderCompleteLog(leader, term_l) ==
  /\ state[leader] = "leader"
  /\ term[leader] = term_l
  /\ \A n \in Node \ {leader}:
       LogMatching(leader, n, Len(log[leader]))

Send(m) ==
  /\ m \in Messages
  /\ messages' = messages \union {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

UpdateTerm(t) ==
  /\ t > term
  /\ term' = t
  /\ state' = [s \in Node |-> IF s = "leader" /\ term[s] > t THEN "follower" ELSE state[s]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votedFor, log, messages>>

RequestVote(from, to, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term) ==
  /\ state[from] = "candidate"
  /\ term[from] = trm
  /\ Len(log[from]) >= last_log_idx
  /\ last_log_term = IF last_log_idx > 0 THEN log[from][last_log_idx].term ELSE 0
  /\ Send([type |-> "RequestVote",
            from |-> from, to |-> to,
            term |-> trm,
            lastLogIndex |-> last_log_idx,
            lastLogTerm |-> last_log_term])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

ReplyVoteRequest(from, to, trm, vote) ==
  /\ Send([type |-> "Vote",
            from |-> from, to |-> to,
            term |-> trm,
            vote |-> vote])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

AppendEntries(from, to, trm, prev_idx, prev_term, entries, leader_commit) ==
  /\ term[from] = trm
  /\ state[from] = "leader"
  /\ Send([type |-> "AppendEntries",
            from |-> from, to |-> to,
            term |-> trm,
            prevLogIndex |-> prev_idx,
            prevLogTerm |-> prev_term,
            entries |-> entries,
            leaderCommit |-> leader_commit])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

ReplyAppendEntries(from, to, trm, success) ==
  /\ Send([type |-> "AppendEntriesReply",
            from |-> from, to |-> to,
            term |-> trm,
            success |-> success])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

BecomeFollower(n, t) ==
  /\ state[n] = "candidate" \/ (state[n] = "leader" /\ term[n] < t)
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![n] = t]
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![n] = "follower"]
  /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<log, messages>>

StartElection(n, t) ==
  /\ state[n] = "follower"
  /\ term[n] < t
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![n] = t]
  /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = [term |-> t, node |-> n]]
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![n] = "candidate"]
  /\ last_log_idx = Len(log[n])
  /\ last_log_term = IF last_log_idx > 0 THEN log[n][last_log_idx].term ELSE 0
  /\ \E to \in Node \ {n}:
       RequestVote(n, to, t, last_log_idx, last_log_term)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<log, messages>>

UpdateElection(n, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term) ==
  /\ state[n] = "candidate"
  /\ term[n] = trm
  /\ Len(log[n]) >= last_log_idx
  /\ (last_log_term = 0 \/ last_log_term > log[n][last_log_idx].term \/
      (last_log_term = log[n][last_log_idx].term /\ Len(log[n]) > last_log_idx))
  /\ \E to \in Node \ {n}:
       RequestVote(n, to, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state, messages>>

GrantVote(n, from, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term) ==
  /\ state[n] = "follower" \/ state[n] = "candidate"
  /\ votedFor[n] = NONE \/ votedFor[n].term < trm
  /\ Len(log[n]) >= last_log_idx
  /\ (last_log_term = 0 \/ last_log_term > log[n][last_log_idx].term \/
      (last_log_term = log[n][last_log_idx].term /\ Len(log[n]) > last_log_idx))
  /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = [term |-> trm, node |-> from]]
  /\ ReplyVoteRequest(n, from, trm, TRUE)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, log, state, messages>>

RejectVote(n, from, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term) ==
  /\ state[n] = "follower" \/ state[n] = "candidate"
  /\ ReplyVoteRequest(n, from, trm, FALSE)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state, messages>>

CheckElection(n) ==
  /\ state[n] = "candidate"
  /\ Cardinality({m \in messages: m.type = "Vote" /\ m.to = n /\ m.term = term[n] /\ m.vote}) >
     Cardinality(Node) \div 2
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![n] = "leader"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, messages>>

AppendToLog(n, entries) ==
  /\ state[n] = "leader"
  /\ \A e \in entries: e.term = term[n]
  /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![n] = Append(log[n], entries)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, state, messages>>

ReplicateLog(n, to, prev_idx, prev_term, entries, leader_commit) ==
  /\ state[n] = "leader"
  /\ Len(log[n]) >= prev_idx
  /\ (prev_idx = 0 \/ log[n][prev_idx].term = prev_term)
  /\ AppendEntries(n, to, term[n], prev_idx, prev_term, entries, leader_commit)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

HandleAppendEntries(n, from, trm, prev_idx, prev_term, entries, leader_commit) ==
  /\ term[n] < trm \/ (term[n] = trm /\ state[n] \in {"follower", "candidate"})
  /\ BecomeFollower(n, trm)
  /\ IF Len(log[n]) >= prev_idx /\ (prev_idx = 0 \/ log[n][prev_idx].term = prev_term)
     THEN
       /\ IF Len(entries) > 0
          THEN
            /\ LET conflict_idx == FIRST {i \in prev_idx+1..Len(log[n]):
                                           log[n][i].term # entries[1].term} \union {Len(log[n])+1}
               IN  IF conflict_idx > prev_idx + Len(entries)
                   THEN
                     /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![n] = log[n]]
                     /\ ReplyAppendEntries(n, from, trm, TRUE)
                   ELSE
                     /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![n] =
                                     Append(SubSeq(log[n], 1, conflict_idx-1), SubSeq(entries, 1, Len(entries)))]
                     /\ ReplyAppendEntries(n, from, trm, FALSE)
          ELSE
            /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![n] = log[n]]
            /\ ReplyAppendEntries(n, from, trm, TRUE)
       /\ IF leader_commit > commitIndex[n]
          THEN commitIndex' = [commitIndex EXCEPT ![n] = leader_commit]
          ELSE UNCHANGED commitIndex
     ELSE
       /\ ReplyAppendEntries(n, from, trm, FALSE)
       /\ UNCHANGED log
  /\ UNCHANGED messages

HandleAppendEntriesReply(n, from, trm, success) ==
  /\ state[n] = "leader"
  /\ term[n] = trm
  /\ IF ~success
     THEN
       /\ nextIndex' = [nextIndex EXCEPT ![n][from] =
                          IF nextIndex[n][from] > 1 THEN nextIndex[n][from] - 1 ELSE 1]
     ELSE
       /\ IF Len(entries[n][from]) > nextIndex[n][from]
          THEN
            /\ UNCHANGED nextIndex
          ELSE
            /\ nextIndex' = [nextIndex EXCEPT ![n][from] = nextIndex[n][from] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state, messages>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Node, t \in Term \ {term[n]}:
       \/ StartElection(n, t)
       \/ BecomeFollower(n, t)
  \/ \E n, to \in Node, t \in Term:
       \/ UpdateElection(n, t, Len(log[n]), IF Len(log[n]) > 0 THEN log[n][Len(log[n])].term ELSE 0)
       \/ GrantVote(to, n, t, Len(log[to]), IF Len(log[to]) > 0 THEN log[to][Len(log[to])].term ELSE 0)
       \/ RejectVote(to, n, t, Len(log[to]), IF Len(log[to]) > 0 THEN log[to][Len(log[to])].term ELSE 0)
  \/ \E n \in Node:
       CheckElection(n)
  \/ \E n \in Node, entries \in SUBSET Log:
       AppendToLog(n, entries)
  \/ \E n, to \in Node, prev_idx \in Nat, prev_term \in Term,
         entries \in SUBSET Log, leader_commit \in Nat:
       ReplicateLog(n, to, prev_idx, prev_term, entries, leader_commit)
  \/ \E n, from \in Node, trm \in Term:
       HandleAppendEntries(n, from, trm, prev_idx, prev_term, entries, leader_commit)
  \/ \E n, from \in Node, trm \in Term:
       HandleAppendEntriesReply(n, from, trm, success)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Invariants ==
  /\ NoLeaderInTwoTerms(term)
  /\ LeaderCompleteLog(leader, term[leader])

THEOREM Spec => Invariants

---- MODULE longrecipe ----
EXTENDS Integers, Reals, Sequences, TLC

CONSTANT MaxSteps, TransformParams
VARIABLES tokens, schedule, current_step, transform_state

TypeOK ==
  /\ tokens \in Seq(Real)
  /\ schedule \in Seq(Real)
  /\ current_step \in Nat
  /\ transform_state \in [1..Len(schedule) -> Real]

Init ==
  /\ tokens = <<1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0>>
  /\ schedule = TransformParams
  /\ current_step = 0
  /\ transform_state = [i \in 1..Len(schedule) |-> 0.0]

ApplyTransform(step, param) ==
  Cos(param * step) + Sin(param * step)

ProcessStep ==
  /\ current_step < MaxSteps
  /\ LET param == schedule[current_step + 1]
     IN  tokens' = << tokens[1] * ApplyTransform(current_step, param),
                      tokens[2] * ApplyTransform(current_step + 1, param),
                      tokens[3] * ApplyTransform(current_step + 2, param),
                      tokens[4] * ApplyTransform(current_step + 3, param) >>
  /\ current_step' = current_step + 1
  /\ transform_state' = [ts \in DOMAIN transform_state |-> ts[current_step + 1] <- param]
  /\ UNCHANGED schedule

Next == ProcessStep \/ (current_step = MaxSteps /\ UNCHANGED <<tokens, schedule, current_step, transform_state>>)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<tokens, schedule, current_step, transform_state>>

Liveness == <> (current_step = MaxSteps)

Convergence == \A s \in 1..MaxSteps: <> (current_step = s)

THEOREM Spec => Liveness
THEOREM Spec => Convergence

CONSTANTS nodes, MaxTerm, NONE

vars == <<term, votedFor, log, state, messages>>

Node == nodes
Term == 0..MaxTerm

InitVoteMsg == [type: "RequestVote", from: Node, to: Node, term: Term, lastLogIndex: Nat, lastLogTerm: Term]
VoteMsg == [type: "Vote", from: Node, to: Node, term: Term, vote: BOOLEAN]
AppendEntriesMsg == [type: "AppendEntries", from: Node, to: Node, term: Term, prevLogIndex: Nat, prevLogTerm: Term, entries: Log, leaderCommit: Nat]
AppendEntriesReplyMsg == [type: "AppendEntriesReply", from: Node, to: Node, term: Term, success: BOOLEAN]

Message == InitVoteMsg \cup VoteMsg \cup AppendEntriesMsg \cup AppendEntriesReplyMsg
Messages == SUBSET Message

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in [Node -> Term]
  /\ votedFor \in [Node -> Option(BallotNumber)]
  /\ log \in [Node -> Log]
  /\ state \in [Node -> {"leader", "follower", "candidate"}]
  /\ messages \in Messages

Init ==
  /\ term = [n \in Node |-> 0]
  /\ votedFor = [n \in Node |-> NONE]
  /\ log = [n \in Node |-> << >>]
  /\ state = [n \in Node |-> "follower"]
  /\ messages = {}

NoLeaderInTwoTerms ==
  \A ts \in Term:
    \A n1, n2 \in Node:
      ((state[n1] = "leader" /\ term[n1] = ts) /\ (state[n2] = "leader" /\ term[n2] = ts)) => n1 = n2

LogMatching(n1, n2, idx) ==
  /\ Len(log[n1]) >= idx
  /\ Len(log[n2]) >= idx
  /\ \A i \in 1..idx:
       log[n1][i] = log[n2][i]

LeaderCompleteLog(leader) ==
  /\ state[leader] = "leader"
  /\ \A n \in Node \ {leader}:
       LogMatching(leader, n, Len(log[leader]))

Send(m) ==
  /\ m \in Message
  /\ messages' = messages \union {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

RequestVote(from, to, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term) ==
  /\ state[from] = "candidate"
  /\ term[from] = trm
  /\ Len(log[from]) >= last_log_idx
  /\ last_log_term = IF last_log_idx > 0 THEN log[from][last_log_idx].term ELSE 0
  /\ Send([type |-> "RequestVote",
            from |-> from, to |-> to,
            term |-> trm,
            lastLogIndex |-> last_log_idx,
            lastLogTerm |-> last_log_term])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

ReplyVoteRequest(from, to, trm, vote) ==
  /\ Send([type |-> "Vote",
            from |-> from, to |-> to,
            term |-> trm,
            vote |-> vote])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

AppendEntries(from, to, trm, prev_idx, prev_term, entries, leader_commit) ==
  /\ term[from] = trm
  /\ state[from] = "leader"
  /\ Send([type |-> "AppendEntries",
            from |-> from, to |-> to,
            term |-> trm,
            prevLogIndex |-> prev_idx,
            prevLogTerm |-> prev_term,
            entries |-> entries,
            leaderCommit |-> leader_commit])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

ReplyAppendEntries(from, to, trm, success) ==
  /\ Send([type |-> "AppendEntriesReply",
            from |-> from, to |-> to,
            term |-> trm,
            success |-> success])
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

BecomeFollower(n, t) ==
  /\ state[n] = "candidate" \/ (state[n] = "leader" /\ term[n] < t)
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![n] = t]
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![n] = "follower"]
  /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = NONE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<log, messages>>

StartElection(n, t) ==
  /\ state[n] = "follower"
  /\ term[n] < t
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![n] = t]
  /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = [term |-> t, node |-> n]]
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![n] = "candidate"]
  /\ last_log_idx = Len(log[n])
  /\ last_log_term = IF last_log_idx > 0 THEN log[n][last_log_idx].term ELSE 0
  /\ \E to \in Node \ {n}:
       RequestVote(n, to, t, last_log_idx, last_log_term)
  /\ UNCHANGED log

UpdateElection(n, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term) ==
  /\ state[n] = "candidate"
  /\ term[n] = trm
  /\ Len(log[n]) >= last_log_idx
  /\ (last_log_term = 0 \/ last_log_term > log[n][last_log_idx].term \/
      (last_log_term = log[n][last_log_idx].term /\ Len(log[n]) > last_log_idx))
  /\ \E to \in Node \ {n}:
       RequestVote(n, to, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

GrantVote(n, from, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term) ==
  /\ state[n] \in {"follower", "candidate"}
  /\ (votedFor[n] = NONE) \/ (votedFor[n] # NONE /\ votedFor[n].term < trm)
  /\ Len(log[n]) >= last_log_idx
  /\ (last_log_term = 0 \/ last_log_term > log[n][last_log_idx].term \/
      (last_log_term = log[n][last_log_idx].term /\ Len(log[n]) > last_log_idx))
  /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = [term |-> trm, node |-> from]]
  /\ ReplyVoteRequest(n, from, trm, TRUE)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, log, state>>

RejectVote(n, from, trm, last_log_idx, last_log_term) ==
  /\ state[n] \in {"follower", "candidate"}
  /\ ReplyVoteRequest(n, from, trm, FALSE)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, state>>

CheckElection(n) ==
  /\ state[n] = "candidate"
  /\ Cardinality({m \in messages: m.type = "Vote" /\ m.to = n /\ m.term = term[n] /\ m.vote}) >
     Cardinality(Node) \div 2
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![n] = "leader"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, log, messages>>

AppendToLog(n, entries) ==
  /\ state[n] = "leader"
  /\ \A i \in 1..Len(entries): entries[i].term = term[n]
  /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![n] = log[n] \o entries]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, votedFor, state, messages>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Node, t \in Term:
       \/ StartElection(n, t)
       \/ BecomeFollower(n, t)
  \/ \E n, to \in Node, t \in Term:
       \/ UpdateElection(n, t, Len(log[n]), IF Len(log[n]) > 0 THEN log[n][Len(log[n])].term ELSE 0)
       \/ GrantVote(to, n, t, Len(log[to]), IF Len(log[to]) > 0 THEN log[to][Len(log[to])].term ELSE 0)
       \/ RejectVote(to, n, t, Len(log[to]), IF Len(log[to]) > 0 THEN log[to][Len(log[to])].term ELSE 0)
  \/ \E n \in Node:
       CheckElection(n)
  \/ \E n \in Node, entries \in Log:
       AppendToLog(n, entries)
  \/ \E from, to \in Node, trm \in Term, prev_idx \in Nat, prev_term \in Term, entries \in Log, leader_commit \in Nat:
       AppendEntries(from, to, trm, prev_idx, prev_term, entries, leader_commit)
  \/ \E from, to \in Node, trm \in Term, success \in BOOLEAN:
       ReplyAppendEntries(from, to, trm, success)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Invariants ==
  /\ NoLeaderInTwoTerms
  /\ \A l \in Node: state[l] # "leader" \/ LeaderCompleteLog(l)

THEOREM Spec => Invariants

---- MODULE longrecipe ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Integers, Reals, Sequences, TLC

CONSTANT MaxSteps, TransformParams, Cos(_), Sin(_)
VARIABLES tokens, schedule, current_step, transform_state

TypeOK ==
  /\ tokens \in Seq(Real)
  /\ schedule \in Seq(Real)
  /\ current_step \in Nat
  /\ transform_state \in [1..Len(schedule) -> Real]

Init ==
  /\ tokens = <<1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0>>
  /\ schedule = TransformParams
  /\ current_step = 0
  /\ transform_state = [i \in 1..Len(schedule) |-> 0.0]

ApplyTransform(step, param) ==
  Cos(param * step) + Sin(param * step)

ProcessStep ==
  /\ current_step < MaxSteps
  /\ LET param == schedule[current_step + 1]
     IN  tokens' = << tokens * ApplyTransform(current_step, param),
                      tokens * ApplyTransform(current_step + 1, param),
                      tokens * ApplyTransform(current_step + 2, param),
                      tokens * ApplyTransform(current_step + 3, param) >>
  /\ current_step' = current_step + 1
  /\ transform_state' = [transform_state EXCEPT ![current_step + 1] = schedule[current_step + 1]]
  /\ UNCHANGED schedule

Next == ProcessStep \/ (current_step = MaxSteps /\ UNCHANGED <<tokens, schedule, current_step, transform_state>>)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<tokens, schedule, current_step, transform_state>>

Liveness == <> (current_step = MaxSteps)

Convergence == \A s \in 1..MaxSteps: <> (current_step = s)

THEOREM Spec => Liveness
THEOREM Spec => Convergence
